categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of daily chemical raw materials, including cosmetic active ingredients such as sunscreen agents and synthetic fragrances. The company also produces amino acid surfactants and anti-dandruff agents for personal care products. Its product portfolio covers a wide range of sunscreen agents addressing UVA and UVB protection and various synthetic fragrance compounds used in cosmetics, detergents, and oral care products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary chemical synthesis technologies including alkylation, acylation, condensation, hydrogenation, oxidation, etherification, and esterification. It has developed patented methods for producing key sunscreen agents and fragrance intermediates, such as Avobenzone, Octocrylene, and synthetic lily aldehyde. The firm emphasizes green chemistry and energy-efficient processes, including decolorization-thin film distillation purification and high-selectivity hydrogenation, to improve product quality and reduce environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major multinational cosmetics companies such as DSM-FMC, Beiersdorf, Procter & Gamble, L'Oréal, Merck, and Johnson & Johnson for sunscreen and cosmetic active ingredients. For synthetic fragrances, clients include global fragrance companies like Givaudan, IFF, Takasago, Mane, and Colgate. The products serve downstream industries including cosmetics, detergents, oral care, and personal care markets worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Nanjing, Suqian, Ma'anshan, Anqing, and Hong Kong. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and production facilities in Singapore and Malaysia, targeting international markets. Overseas sales account for nearly 90% of revenue, reflecting a strong global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of fine chemical raw materials for personal care and fragrance industries. It sources chemical raw materials and produces specialty ingredients that are then supplied to downstream brand owners and formulators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a focus on developing new sunscreen agents with broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection and safer, more effective synthetic fragrances. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance product safety, efficacy, and environmental sustainability. The firm is expanding its product portfolio to include amino acid surfactants and other personal care raw materials, while also exploring emerging fields like synthetic biology. It aims to strengthen its formulation application capabilities to better serve customers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical raw materials and specialty ingredients to large multinational cosmetics and fragrance companies. The company employs a direct sales model for large customers and uses distributors for smaller or regionally concentrated clients. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, reflecting a product sales-based revenue model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing COSMOS Chemical is one of the world's leading manufacturers of sunscreen agents and a major player in the synthetic fragrance industry. It competes with global specialty chemical suppliers serving the personal care sector. The company holds a strong market position due to its comprehensive product portfolio, certifications (including FDA and EFfCI), and robust R&D capabilities, enabling it to maintain a competitive edge internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.4 billion, representing a 36% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 733 million, an 89% increase. Operating cash flow grew by 178%. The company has expanded production capacity and improved utilization rates, supporting sustained growth. Total assets reached nearly RMB 3.9 billion, up 71% from the prior year, reflecting significant investment in new projects and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and effective cosmetic active ingredients and synthetic fragrances with broad-spectrum UV protection and innovative formulations. Its strong R&D foundation, patented technologies, and comprehensive product lines enable tailored solutions for diverse customer needs. Certifications from FDA and EFfCI, along with stringent quality and environmental management systems, differentiate it as a reliable global supplier. The company also offers integrated formulation support services, enhancing customer value beyond raw material supply.
